title: Senior Applications Engineer I
description:
**Job Summary:**

If you are a Quotation professional, Emerson has an exciting role for you! We are looking for a Application Engineer to work with our North American Team. This role is responsible to provide independent engineering support for Control valve and Regulators to both the dedicated and non\-dedicated impact partner assigned accounts for any project related enquiries. Perform Sizing and selection of control valves using proprietary FisherFirst2 software. Prepare Technical and Commercial Quote, technical deviations list, generate reports, drawings. Contact GIS teams for any technical/special price requirements. This role will work independently to support the inside sales network in North America region. You will be responsible for working with Industry sales team and Product engineers on finalizing solutions for severe service applications in process industry.


**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

Review project specifications and prepare deviations list  



  

Clarify doubts on technical specifications through conference calls with Sales office/LBP  



  

Sizing and selection of control valves using proprietary FisherFirst software  



  

Contact GIS/SPG teams as and when required for critical application solutions/special prices  



  

Prepare Technical and Commercial Quote, technical deviations list and generate reports and drawings  



  

Provide support on project revisions from Customer  



  

Support Sales office after the issue of PO and prepare transaction for order entry  



  

Provide technical support for OE /factory clarifications and assist with change orders  



  

Maintain records of all work done.  



  

Key contact for all technical issues related to the LBP supported  



  

Check quotations based on MIB strategy made by less experienced engineers and document errors and act as a


mentor in the team  



  

Monitor RDSL, PDSL \& RFT performance for the LBP supported  



  

Analyse RFQ scope \& resource availability and commit to a deadline  



  

Handle internal training programs  



  

Readiness for Inhouse engineer support  



  

Able to handle all severe service applications  



  

Independently handle quote to commit process  



  

Experienced to handle TBE meetings with customers independently.  



  

Troubleshoot site issues


  



**Who You Are:**

You quickly and significantly take action in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well\-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain.


**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Minimum 3\-year experience of any Engineering background.
* Knowledge of all Fisher products and accessories.
* Understanding of product specifications and Incoterms.
* Adequate knowledge of sizing control valves for industry specific applications
* Knowledge of MIB strategy \& implementation skilled in using the FF2 tool
* Basic knowledge of Inactive/obsolete/Competitor products.
* Degree in Mechanical/Instrumentation/Chemical/Metallurgical Engineering.
* Basic understanding of MS word, excel and power point.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Our Culture \& Commitment to You:**

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.  



We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave

title: Field Service Engineer – ISP
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer\-oriented **Field Service Engineer** to support our ISP network operations. The role involves installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and restoration of broadband, FTTH/FTTx, fiber\-optic, Wi\-Fi, and networking services at customer and network locations.

The candidate will work closely with the **NOC, Installation, Customer Care, and Network Operations teams** to ensure timely service delivery, network availability, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install and commission **FTTH/FTTx broadband connections**, ONT/ONU, routers, Wi\-Fi devices, and other CPE equipment.
* Perform fiber cable routing, termination, jointing, and basic **fiber splicing** activities.
* Troubleshoot broadband connectivity, low\-speed, signal\-loss, Wi\-Fi, and network\-related complaints.
* Check optical signal levels and identify fiber cuts, attenuation, connector issues, and last\-mile faults.
* Perform testing using **OTDR, Optical Power Meter, VFL, Fusion Splicer**, and other fiber\-testing equipment.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, ONT/ONU, Wi\-Fi routers, switches, and basic networking equipment.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance of the access/last\-mile network.
* Attend customer complaints and service requests within the defined **SLA/TAT**.
* Conduct site surveys and feasibility checks for new customer connections.
* Coordinate with the **NOC/L2/L3 teams** for issues requiring backend or advanced technical support.
* Support fault restoration for OFC, distribution boxes, FDPs, splitters, and other access\-network infrastructure.
* Maintain proper records of installations, complaints, fault restoration, materials, and customer sign\-offs.
* Ensure proper utilization and maintenance of company tools, equipment, vehicles, and network materials.
* Explain basic equipment usage and troubleshooting procedures to customers.
* Follow company technical standards, safety procedures, and field\-service guidelines.
* Be available for rotational shifts, emergency maintenance, weekends, or holidays when required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **FTTH, FTTx, GPON, OFC, LAN/WAN, Ethernet, and TCP/IP**.
* Knowledge of **ONT/ONU, OLT, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and CPE**.
* Basic understanding of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, and network troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on knowledge of fiber splicing and testing is preferred.
* Ability to identify and troubleshoot fiber cuts, optical power loss, and connectivity issues.
* Knowledge of OTDR and Optical Power Meter is an added advantage.

**Qualification**

* ITI / Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in **Electronics, Telecommunication, Electrical, Computer Science, IT, or related disciplines**.
* **1–3 years** of experience in ISP, broadband, telecom, networking, or field service operations.
* Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may also be considered.

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid **Two\-Wheeler Driving Licence** preferred/mandatory as per business requirement.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned service area.
* Good communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Ability to work independently in outdoor/field conditions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts and during emergency network restoration.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Installation completion within SLA.
* First\-Time Resolution (FTR) of customer complaints.
* Fault restoration TAT.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Network/service quality.
* Preventive maintenance completion.
* Proper utilization of tools and materials.
* Accurate service documentation and reporting.

**Preferred Skills**

**FTTH \| FTTx \| GPON \| Fiber Optics \| OFC \| OTDR \| Optical Power Meter \| Fusion Splicing \| ONT/ONU \| OLT \| LAN/WAN \| TCP/IP \| Router Configuration \| Wi\-Fi Troubleshooting \| Customer Handling \| SLA Management**

**Candidate Profile:** A hands\-on technical professional who can independently attend customer locations, troubleshoot fiber/broadband issues, coordinate with the NOC, and ensure reliable ISP service delivery.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Secondary(10th Pass) (Preferred)

Experience:

* Field service: 1 year (Preferred)

Language:

* Tamil (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

description:

* Install and configure **ONT/ONU, routers, Wi\-Fi devices, and other CPE equipment**.
* Troubleshoot fiber connectivity, signal loss, power issues, and customer\-side network problems.

title: Network Engineering and Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Role description**  


UST is looking for an experienced Network Engineering and Service Delivery Manager to lead enterprise network engineering, operations, and customer delivery engagements. The ideal candidate will bring strong proficiency in **Network Engineering, including Routing \& Switching and LAN/WAN \& SD\-WAN**, combined with expertise in **Network Operations \& Troubleshooting** and **Network Engineering Delivery Management / Service Delivery**.
The role requires experience managing enterprise network environments, leading technical teams, maintaining reliable network operations, and delivering measurable service outcomes. The successful candidate will also have intermediate\-level experience with **AWS OR Azure OR GCP** to support cloud\-connected and hybrid networking environments.
Key Responsibilities

* Provide technical and operational leadership for **Network Engineering, including Routing \& Switching and LAN/WAN \& SD\-WAN**.
* Oversee **Network Operations \& Troubleshooting**, including incident management, escalations, service restoration, problem resolution, and continuous service improvement.
* Apply **Network Engineering Delivery Management / Service Delivery** practices to manage delivery commitments, operational performance, governance, and customer expectations.
* Drive SLA and KPI adherence while identifying opportunities to improve network reliability, service quality, and operational efficiency.
* Support cloud\-connected and hybrid network environments using **AWS OR Azure OR GCP**, depending on the applicable project environment.
* Lead network transformation, migration, and modernization initiatives aligned with operational and delivery objectives.
* Manage customer relationships, governance reviews, escalations, and executive\-level communications.
* Provide leadership and guidance to Network Engineers and Technical Leads.
* Support resource planning, hiring, team development, and the effective allocation of network engineering capabilities.

### **Proficient**


* Network Engineering: Routing \& Switching, LAN/WAN \& SD\-WAN
* Network Operations \& Troubleshooting
* Network Engineering Delivery Management / Service Delivery

### **Intermediate**


* AWS OR Azure OR GCP

Experience Requirements
* 14\+ years of overall IT experience.
* Minimum 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Network Engineering.
* Minimum 3\+ years of Delivery Management experience leading network operations or engineering teams.
* Experience managing enterprise network environments and customer\-facing engagements.


  

**Skills**  


### **Proficient**


* Network Engineering: Routing \& Switching, LAN/WAN \& SD\-WAN
* Network Operations \& Troubleshooting
* Network Engineering Delivery Management / Service Delivery

### **Intermediate**


* AWS OR Azure OR GCP


  

**About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. title: Senior Order Execution Specialist
description:
Create a better future!  

Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future? We believe we can develop technology and gain the knowledge to make that difference. We have launched our ambition, Mission Zero – enabling our customers to move towards zero emissions in mining and cement. We need your leadership skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfill our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials needed for a better future.

 **Department**  

You will be part of Supply Chain Execution, Africa Region

 **Senior Order Execution Specialist**  

Manages end\-to\-end spare parts order execution, ensuring timely delivery, process compliance, and customer satisfaction.


Manages aftermarket projects for mining customers through cross\-functional coordination, order execution, and customer engagement.

**Key Responsibilities / Key Individual** **Accountabilities**  

* Own the order handling process for standard spare parts from receipt of purchase order to delivery and invoicing
* Validate customer orders against proposals and ensure all required information is available for order entry
* Accurately enter orders in ERP/CRM systems and track their progress through to fulfillment
* Monitor lead times, material availability, and production schedules to ensure on\-time delivery (SIFOT/DIFOT)
* Coordinate with Procurement, Planning, and Logistics to ensure smooth execution of each order
* Communicate proactively with customers regarding order confirmations, delivery schedules, and any delays
* Ensure compliance with export control, documentation, and invoicing requirements
* Handle changes, cancellations, and urgent order escalations efficiently and professionally
* Collaborate with Customer Relations and Sales to follow up on overdue receivables when required
* Manage customer communication, order status updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Prepare and maintain revenue, order intake, backlog, and delivery performance reports.
* Arrange and facilitate customer meetings, reviews, and follow\-up actions.
* Collaborate closely with key Russian\-speaking customers and stakeholders, leveraging Russian language proficiency to support business operations and customer satisfaction.
* Document and close orders in alignment with internal policies and ensure traceability of records.
**Interface with Internal Stake Holders:**  

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with customer, sales, procurement, logistics \& Engineering to ensure timely execution of orders.
* Observes and executes all job responsibilities in accordance with established company policies, procedures, and FLS standards
* Implements improvements to team business processes
* Promotes a culture of personal and team safety, including others who may be affected by the company’s operational activities
 **What you bring**  

* You are a Global Business Engineer or have a comparable background.
* Your previous career has provided you with experience within the cross field of proposal/ order execution /customer relations.
* You are used to foreseeing and solving potential problems.
* You are proactive and have a structured approach to your tasks, enabling you to handle several cases at a time.
* You have a cross\-cultural understanding and can communicate with people of different nationalities and professional backgrounds.
 **Education**

* TCP/IP, Linux/Shell Scripting, Packet Capture/WireShark, Jira, Wiki, Test Director

description:
**Senior Executive – Recruitment \& Project Staffing Coordination**

**Company:** Greenwarrior

**Department:** Human Resources \& Project Operations

**Location:** Thiruvallur

**Experience:** Preferably 4–7 years in recruitment and manpower mobilisation

**Employment:** Full\-time

**Role Purpose**

We are seeking a multilingual recruitment and staffing professional with experience in recruiting blue\-collar manpower for municipal solid waste management and mining operations, along with the ability to recruit white\-collar professionals for the waste management industry.

Our recruitment requirements depend on ongoing projects, bidding opportunities and new contract awards. This role combines recruitment with manpower planning, field staffing support, employee coordination and recruitment readiness during periods of limited hiring.

**Blue Collar Recruitment and Mobilisation**

· Recruit sanitation workers, waste collection workers, segregation workers, helpers, drivers, equipment operators, mechanics, electricians, welders and other project manpower.

· Source workers for mining operations, including relevant equipment operators, maintenance personnel, drivers and site support staff.

· Manage sourcing, screening, interview coordination, document collection, joining and deployment.

· Coordinate with project teams to verify driving licences, trade skills, operating experience and other role\-specific requirements.

· Arrange recruitment drives and coordinate worker travel, reporting locations and accommodation requirements with authorised project teams.

· Maintain backup candidates for urgent replacements, absenteeism and project mobilisation.

**Recruitment and Staffing Responsibilities Interstate Recruitment Networks**

· Possess and maintain an active network of recruitment agents, manpower suppliers, local coordinators, employee referrals, ITIs and skill\-training institutions across different states.

· Develop sourcing channels for both local and interstate manpower.

· Assess recruitment partners based on candidate quality, joining reliability, retention and agreed recruitment costs.

· Maintain a source database recording locations served, categories available, contact details and recruitment performance.

· Communicate wages, duties, shifts, location and facilities accurately to candidates; escalate misleading promises or unauthorised recruitment charges.

**White Collar Recruitment**

· Recruit Project Managers, engineers, plant and maintenance personnel, supervisors, safety officers, HR executives, accounts staff, procurement personnel, MIS executives and tendering staff for waste management projects.

· Prepare job descriptions with department heads, screen candidates and coordinate technical interviews.

· Handle compensation discussions within approved budgets and follow through on offers, notice periods and joining.

· Build candidate pipelines for anticipated project requirements.

**Field Staffing and Project HR Coordination**

· Act as the staffing coordination contact between the corporate office, Field Managers and Project Company HR Managers.

· Obtain manpower requirements and track sanctioned strength, deployment, vacancies, absenteeism and replacement needs.

· Provide regular staffing updates to Field Managers and management.

· Liaise with Project HR Managers on joining formalities, attendance discrepancies, transfers, accommodation issues, employee concerns and exits.

· Coordinate timely replacements and support retention of newly recruited workers.

· Escalate staffing shortages and unresolved employee issues that may affect project operations.

**Project and Bid Stage Support**

· Support management with manpower availability, indicative recruitment lead times and sourcing inputs for proposed projects and bids.

· Prepare recruitment and mobilisation plans based on approved project staffing requirements.

· Maintain a ready pool of suitable candidates and recruitment partners for new project awards.

· Communicate clearly when an opportunity is conditional on a contract award; issue commitments only after internal approval.

Candidate Requirements and PerformanceResponsibilities During Low Hiring Periods

· Update candidate databases, recruitment partner records and employee skill inventories.

· Follow up with deployed employees and project teams on retention, staffing gaps and pending onboarding documents.

· Coordinate redeployment opportunities between projects.

· Support HR documentation, induction scheduling, training coordination and staffing\-related administrative work.

· Prepare recruitment and manpower reports, and maintain readiness for upcoming projects.

**Language Requirements**

· **Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, English and Kannada**: Working conversational proficiency required to communicate with candidates, recruitment agents and project teams.

· Ability to explain job conditions, wages, shifts, deployment locations and joining requirements clearly in the above languages.

· Ability to prepare professional emails, recruitment trackers and reports in English. Reading and writing ability in regional languages will be an added advantage.

**Education and Experience**

· Graduate in any discipline; MBA / MSW / postgraduate qualification in Human Resources preferred.

· Preferably 4–7 years of relevant experience in recruitment, manpower mobilisation or project staffing.

· Hands\-on blue\-collar recruitment experience in municipal waste management and mining operations.

· Demonstrated ability to recruit white\-collar personnel for waste management or related project operations.

· Proven interstate sourcing network and experience coordinating with recruitment agents and project HR teams. Candidates with strong practical experience and established sourcing networks may be considered with equivalent qualifications.

**Essential Skills**

Multilingual communication and negotiation; recruitment planning, screening and joining follow\-up; relationship management with agents and project teams; ability to handle urgent requirements and changing priorities; proficiency in Excel, email, recruitment portals, candidate databases and MIS reporting; willingness to travel; and ability to work independently across recruitment, staffing coordination and related HR support duties.

**Performance Measures**

Timely fulfilment of approved manpower requirements; candidate joining rates and retention at 30, 60 and 90 days; replacement speed and quality; recruitment cost within approved budgets; sourcing partner reliability; accurate staffing reports and onboarding records; responsiveness to field and HR teams; and candidate pipeline readiness.

Performance will be assessed against actual project requirements and staffing support delivered, recognising that recruitment volumes vary with project awards.

**Compensation:** Based on relevant experience, language proficiency, industry exposure and demonstrated recruitment network.

title: Technical Manager - SOC
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead Cybersecurity Engineer to lead the design, engineering, deployment, optimization, and ongoing improvement of enterprise security controls and platforms. The role requires strong hands\-on expertise across EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, Microsoft 365 Security, identity security, vulnerability management, and security automation. The successful candidate will drive technical implementation initiatives, strengthen detection and response capabilities, support SOC operations, and ensure security controls align with organizational strategy, risk posture, and compliance requirements.

  

  

Key Responsibilities :


* Lead the design, engineering, deployment, and continuous improvement of enterprise security tools and platforms, including EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, and Microsoft 365 security solutions.
* Architect and implement scalable security controls to protect endpoints, networks, cloud workloads, identity systems, and business\-critical infrastructure.
* Manage and optimize integrations across security platforms, including EDR, SIEM, SOAR, MDM, IAM, and related monitoring tools.
* Drive incident detection and response engineering through alert tuning, detection use case development, correlation logic, and automation playbooks.
* Oversee deployment and enforcement of endpoint security controls, including DLP, USB/device control, device compliance policies, and endpoint hardening standards.
* Collaborate with SOC, Infrastructure, IAM, Cloud, and application teams to ensure security controls are implemented, monitored, and operationalized effectively.
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for security events, tool failures, policy issues, log ingestion gaps, and control effectiveness concerns.
* Establish and maintain SIEM use cases, correlation rules, dashboards, reports, and operational metrics to improve monitoring and executive visibility.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, validate scan results, support remediation planning, and track risk reduction activities through closure.
* Participate in change management processes to assess security impact, define control requirements, and ensure security tooling remains aligned with approved changes.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell, Python, SOAR workflows, and other scripting methods to reduce manual effort and improve response consistency.
* Develop and maintain security baselines, hardening standards, deployment playbooks, operational guides, and technical documentation.
* Monitor emerging threats, threat intelligence, and adversary techniques to adapt detections and controls based on current attack trends.
* Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to junior engineers, SOC analysts, and cross\-functional teams.
  

  

Technical Responsibilities


* Engineer, deploy, and administer EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, including policy tuning, threat detection, response actions, and control validation.
* Implement and manage SIEM platforms such as CrowdStrike NG SIEM or Splunk, including log onboarding, parsing, normalization, dashboarding, and advanced correlation logic.
* Design, implement, and support IDS/IPS and network security monitoring solutions to improve threat visibility, prevention, and investigation capability.
* Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 Security capabilities, including Microsoft Defender Suite, Entra ID, Conditional Access, Secure Score improvements, and identity protection controls.
* Manage MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent solutions for device compliance, device posture, policy enforcement, and access control.
* Implement of identity security controls, including MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access controls, least privilege, and Zero Trust principles.
* Build and maintain SOC automation and SOAR workflows for incident triage, evidence collection, containment actions, enrichment, notification, and reporting.
* Integrate and manage threat intelligence feeds across security tools to support proactive detection, enrichment, and threat hunting.
* Perform log source integration across servers, endpoints, network devices, cloud platforms, firewalls, identity systems, and business\-critical applications.
* Support compliance and audit activities, including HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS\-aligned evidence gathering, configuration review, reporting, and technical control validation.
  

  

Required Skills and Experience


* Strong hands\-on experience in security engineering, control implementation, and enterprise security tool deployment.
* Proven expertise in incident detection, incident response, alert tuning, threat hunting, and SOC enablement.
* Experience with firewalls, endpoint protection, cloud security controls, identity controls, and Microsoft security ecosystems.
* Working knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex multi\-layer security issues across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and application environments.
* Strong understanding of modern attack techniques, adversary behaviors, MITRE ATT\&CK framework, and detection engineering principles.
* Experience working in fast\-paced SOC, security engineering, or enterprise security operations environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, technical leadership, prioritization, and project execution skills.
  

  

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in IT Security, including at least 5\+ years in security engineering, implementation, or platform administration roles.
* Hands\-on experience with EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, Microsoft 365 Security, IAM/PAM, vulnerability management, and cloud security controls.
* Strong understanding of security frameworks and benchmarks, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and CIS Benchmarks.
